The note's claim is incorrect: phosphocreatine resynthesis is not an instantaneous chemical reversal and does depend on oxidative metabolism, so it is not restored within seconds. Near-complete resynthesis after very high intensity exercise typically takes several minutes (fast phase within ~30–60 seconds, full restoration roughly 5–8 minutes). Of the offered options, neither fits well, but "about 30 minutes" is closer to the true timescale than "about 10 seconds."
CONFIDENCE: 80
